article.intro: In xianxia, a cultivator who reaches the top earns a title, and it's usually the name everyone remembers. This **cultivator title generator** makes titles for immortals, sword cultivators, demonic cultivators and alchemists, from Immortal Venerable of the Jade Peak to the Drunken Sword Saint.

sections.heading: Titles in the martial world
sections.content:
In xianxia a title is the name everyone remembers, earned by power, a deed or a reputation.

  • Daoist titles lie behind many of them: zhenren, the "perfected person", and xian, an immortal.
  • Venerable, Sovereign and Monarch show how far up the cultivation ladder someone has climbed.
  • An epithet tells a story in a word: drunken, mad, lonely, merciless.

sections.heading: Choosing a title
sections.content:
• Immortals sit on mountains and live forever: Immortal Venerable of the Jade Peak.
  • Sword cultivators are known by their blade: the Drunken Sword Monarch, Sword Fairy of the Last Light.
  • Demonic cultivators are feared: the Lonely Ghost King.
  • Alchemists make pills that grant power: Pill Saint of the Red Furnace, Cauldron Master of the Hundred Herbs.

For the cultivator's name, try the Wuxia Name Generator, and for their signature move, the Cultivation Technique Name Generator.

For the rest of the martial world, see all the wuxia and xianxia name generators.

faqs.question: What are good xianxia titles?
faqs.answer: A rank and a story: the Drunken Sword Monarch, Immortal Venerable of the Jade Peak, Pill Saint of the Red Furnace.

faqs.question: What does zhenren mean?
faqs.answer: Perfected person, a Daoist title for someone who has realised the Way. It's behind many cultivator titles.

faqs.question: What does a cultivator do?
faqs.answer: In xianxia, a cultivator trains their inner energy through meditation, techniques and pills, climbing realm by realm towards immortality.
